text:
emma_sales: Hey team — quick question. Prospect wants a 6-week POC that bundles API + Optimize + Console premium features. They're asking for a single blended POC rate and a follow-on 3‑month commit option if POC succeeds. Any constraints or must-have approvals? cc @dave_dealdesk

raj_se: Can we do a trial discount for a cross-product POC? Need to check capacity and whether we can spin up a dev pool. Also: expected tokens/day?

olivia_revops: For short trials we normally allow up to 40% off list for 4–6 weeks. Cross-product discounts that materially affect TCV (> $50k) need deal desk sign-off. If they convert to a commit we can layer reserved-capacity credits. @dave_dealdesk — heads up.

dave_dealdesk: Put a formal approval ticket with justification and ARR motion. Quick verbal here: ok to discuss but formal approval required for any cross-product special terms. Typical turnaround ~48h once ticket is complete.

raj_se: Tech notes — suggest provisioning a small dev cluster (2x A10 or v100 equivalents) and enabling Optimize batching to reduce per-token spend. I can draft an SOW for the POC infra. Also, limit Console retention for the POC to avoid extra storage fees.

liam_pm: FYI Console premium includes longer analytics retention and advanced dashboards — for POC we should limit retention to 7 days and disable heavy exports. That keeps the price sensible.

sec_bot: Security checklist — if they plan to ingest customer data, we need a signed DPA and IP/PD handling outlined. For PII, recommend VPC/private deployment or redaction. Security review for any ingestion of customer data is ~3 business days.

emma_sales: Prospect insists on a single blended per-token price during the POC and a clear convert path. Drafting preliminary numbers below — sanity check before I propose to them.

emma_sales: ```
POC proposal (6 weeks)
- API generation: $0.012 / 1k tokens (blended)
- Optimize seats: $1,200 / seat / month (2 seats)
- Console premium access (limited retention): $750 / month
Estimated POC cost (pre-discount): ~$15,500
Applying 40% trial discount => Estimated net POC cost: ~$9,300
Convert option (3 months): 15% conversion credit on monthly invoices if signed within 30 days of POC end (proposed)
```

olivia_revops: Numbers look directionally fine but the 15% conversion credit is on the generous side for cross-product deals. Recommend a performance-tied credit: 10% credit if they hit a usage threshold on conversion (e.g., > $X/month), and cap total credits to protect margin. Also document billing treatment (apply as invoice credits over 2 months).

dave_dealdesk: Approve to move to formal review with the following adjustments: 40% trial discount, conversion credit 10% tied to >$X/month usage, and a clause "no retroactive credits beyond 45 days". Need the formal ticket with SOW + expected TCV and legal remarks.

raj_se: I'll scope the demo infra and SOW. Emma — confirm expected peak tokens/day and whether they require private deployment for the POC.

emma_sales: They expect ~=2M tokens/day at peak. They will send their security questionnaire today; some PII possible, so anticipate privacy constraints and a potential move to private VPC for the full conversion.

sec_bot: If PII is involved, open a privacy review immediately. For the POC we can offer pseudonymization + limited retention, but no raw PII stored beyond 7 days without DPA in place.

emma_sales: Thanks all — I'll open the deal desk ticket and attach this thread + the SOW draft. cc @olivia_revops for formal pricing sheet to attach to the ticket.

olivia_revops: On it. I'll produce the price sheet and submit the approval request within 24 hours. :thumbsup:

dave_dealdesk: Once ticket is in, ping me and I'll prioritize. :rocket:
